custom_scripts_placeholder: Paste the complete analytics snippet, including <script> tags
custom_scripts_help: Supports complete Google Analytics, Baidu Analytics, and other snippets. Multiple snippets can be pasted together. Saved code is inserted into the head of home, applications, bookmarks, help, and local search result pages. Clear and save to disable.
custom_scripts_trust: Scripts run in visitors' browsers. Only add code from trusted sources. Settings and editor pages do not load these scripts.
footer_placeholder: Enter footer text with limited HTML
footer_help: Leave empty to hide the footer. Limited HTML such as a, br, strong, em, span, small, and code is allowed. Scripts, styles, event attributes, and unsafe links are removed automatically.
keep_letter_case: Keep link case consistent with config
icon_mode_default: Hide icons for items without explicit icons
greetings_help: Use a single text like "Hello". Use 4 items split by semicolons for time-based greetings: "Good morning;Good noon;Good afternoon;Good evening". Use 2, 3, or more than 4 items to show one random greeting on each refresh.
module_title_placeholder: Leave empty to use the default title
module_title_help: Leave empty to use the localized default title.
use_theme_color_help: Leave empty to keep the theme color. Accepts rgba(), rgb(), or hex colors.
search_mode_help: Choose whether the home search box filters local bookmarks or jumps to an external search engine.
search_engine_help: Used when search mode is set to search engine.
search_engine_open_mode_help: Choose whether search engine results open in the current tab or a new tab.
search_engine_custom_template_help: Use an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL. Put %s where the search query belongs.
search_engine_custom_template_invalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL with a fixed host and a %s placeholder.
search_engine_custom_template_fallback: The custom search template is invalid. Bookmark search is active until the template is corrected in Search settings.
search_engine_label: Enter a keyword to open %s search
search_engine_label_new_tab: Enter a keyword to open %s search in a new tab
about_desc_1: SuperFlare is a lightweight self-hosted start page for individuals, focused on high performance and very low resource usage. It helps organize scattered bookmarks, quickly reach LAN services, and manage shortcuts.
about_desc_2: It is deeply enhanced from the open-source GitHub project soulteary/docker-flare and includes login protection, online editing, backup and restore, automatic port discovery, personalized theme customization, automatic icon completion, and multilingual UI support.
about_desc_3: SuperFlare can be deployed conveniently on VPS, LAN, and other environments.
site_icon_help: Choose an MDI icon name. Leave empty to use the default favicon. Full icon library:
custom_background_image_help: Use a remote image URL, local static path, or upload an image below. Leave empty to use the theme background.
upload_background_image_help: Uploaded images are stored locally and replace the background image path above.
home_max_columns_help: 0 uses the default. The layout automatically reduces columns when the viewport is narrower.
home_max_width_help: Unit: px. 0 uses the default width.
custom_theme_help: Accepts rgba(), rgb(), or hex colors. Saving selects the custom theme.
login_pass_config_placeholder: Leave both password fields empty to keep the current password
login_pass_confirm_placeholder: Enter the same password again when changing it
login_pass_confirm_error: The two login passwords do not match.
login_config_runtime_fallback: Persistent login config could not be read. This page is showing the runtime credentials instead. Check config.yml and .env content and permissions.
login_config_runtime_source: config.yml login fields are empty. This page is showing the active runtime credentials; saving will persist them to config.yml and .env.
default_login_credentials_warning: The factory default login credentials are still active. Change the username and password before exposing this service.
login_config_help: The login username cannot be empty. Leave both password fields empty to keep the current password. Saving syncs both config.yml and .env.
ports_help: Port collection is enabled by default and runs only when this page is opened or refreshed. Turn it off and save to stop collecting system ports and process information; saved remarks and hidden state remain editable in ports.yaml. Docker collects container ports by default; mount the host /proc and set FLARE_PORT_PROC_ROOT to collect host ports.
editor_port_host_missing: To select saved ports here, set the SuperFlare LAN URL in Appearance settings or open the editor through its LAN address.
editor_category_in_use: Bookmarks or undo history still use this category. Rename it instead of clearing its name.
editor_category_reserved: The category name “{name}” is reserved. Choose another name.
editor_category_duplicate: The category name “{name}” is already in use. Choose another name.
editor_category_name_required: Category row {row} needs a name. Enter a name or remove the row before saving.
editor_bookmark_name_required: Bookmark row {row} needs a name. Enter a name or remove the row before saving.
editor_bookmark_url_required: Bookmark row {row} needs a URL. Enter a URL or remove the row before saving.
editor_bookmark_category_missing: The bookmark “{name}” refers to a category that does not exist: “{category}”.
port_collection_disabled: Port collection is disabled. Only saved remarks and hidden state are shown.
ports_discard_changes: Discard unsaved port changes and save the collection setting?
ports_revision_conflict: The port settings have changed. Your edits are still here. Copy any edits you want to keep before refreshing the port list.
ports_all_hidden: All ports in the current table are marked hidden.
ports_all_unhidden: All ports in the current table are unhidden.
seo_help: Improve how search engines and AI assistants discover this start page. Leave a field empty to fall back to the built-in default.
seo_site_url_help: Absolute public address of this site, used for canonical links, sitemap.xml and llms.txt. Leave empty to derive it from the request.
seo_description_help: Used by the meta description, Open Graph and JSON-LD. Leave empty to use the built-in description.
seo_keywords_help: Comma separated keywords for the meta keywords tag. Leave empty to use the built-in keywords.
seo_image_help: Absolute URL or site-relative path of the Open Graph image. Leave empty to use the site icon.
seo_author_help: Name published in the JSON-LD author field. Leave empty to omit it.
seo_noindex_help: When enabled, robots.txt disallows crawlers and every page is marked noindex. Useful for private intranet deployments.
seo_preview_help: These endpoints are generated from the current settings and can be opened directly.
seo_default_description: SuperFlare is a lightweight, self-hosted navigation homepage for personal use: organize scattered bookmarks, reach intranet services fast, and manage a personal start page with minimal resource usage.
seo_desc_home: SuperFlare, your self-hosted start page: collect frequently used bookmarks and applications, jump into intranet services, and manage everything with multiple themes and near-zero resource usage.
seo_desc_apps: SuperFlare application launcher: browse self-hosted apps grouped by directory, each with icons and descriptions, and reach internal or public services in one click.
seo_desc_bookmarks: SuperFlare bookmark navigation: a categorised personal bookmark library with encrypted links, local addresses and automatic icon resolution.
seo_desc_help: SuperFlare help: learn how each home page module works, plus keyboard shortcuts, search modes and personalisation options.
seo_keywords_default: SuperFlare,start page,self-hosted navigation,bookmark manager,intranet dashboard,personal homepage,open source start page
seo_llms_summary: SuperFlare is a lightweight, self-hosted personal navigation homepage that organises bookmarks, applications and intranet services.
local_network_direct_fallback: Open external link immediately when LAN is not confirmed
